# Some coins misbehave in the cave

### What happens
`recording.mp4` is an uncut run through a cave basin. Twice during the clip, Tux does something that releases a group of new coins. From the first of those moments until the end of the clip, the released coins do not behave the way coins in this game should. The coins that were already placed in the level, Tux, the animals and the scenery in the recording are correct.

### Expected
Each group of released coins should behave like a normal coin burst in this game, from the moment they spread out of their block until they come to rest and Tux goes back to collect them. Once a coin is within the basin's surrounding environment, it should drift down slowly, from the moment it enters it. Fix every way the released coins behave wrongly in the recording.

## Attached visual evidence

- `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4` (47 seconds)

You can inspect individual moments of the video by extracting frames from it with `ffmpeg`.

Inspect the attached file before making changes.

"I fixed the released coins. There are four separate faults, all in `src/object/coin.cpp`, `coin.hpp` and `coin_explode.cpp`. Both changed files compile cleanly. I didn't finish a full rebuild of the game (it ran out of time) and haven't replayed the level, so this is untested in play.

What the recording shows, and the cause of each:

1. **The second burst flies out much wider than the first.** The coin burst code kept its list of launch speeds as shared, persistent data and multiplied it in place each time. Every burst after the first was thrown about 70–100× harder. It now scales a copy of each speed and leaves the base values alone.
2. **Coins never come to rest.** On landing, any coin falling faster than 20 bounced back up, and gravity pushes it past 20 again every time, so they hopped forever. Their sideways speed was also never cleared, so they kept sliding. Now only coins falling faster than 200 bounce (once), and a coin that lands stops completely.
3. **Tux can't collect the released coins.** They were in a collision group that only touches walls and floors, never Tux. I put them back in the normal moving group. Rocks, trampolines and crushers already have code to ignore these coins, which only makes sense in that group.
4. **Coins vanish once they're off-screen.** Any coin below the bottom of the camera was deleted, so when Tux swam up the coins on the floor disappeared before he came back for them. Now a coin is only removed if it falls out of the bottom of the level.

**Water:** the coins previously ignored water entirely and fell through it at full speed. Now, on any frame a coin is touching water, gravity is weakened to 30% (the figure fireballs and enemies already use in water) and its sinking speed is capped at 80. It slows to a drift from the first frame it's in the water. The upward spread of the burst is unchanged; only the descent is slowed.

80 is my own choice of how slow "slowly" should be, and the cap only applies to sinking, not to the burst rising. It's one constant, `WATER_MAX_SINK_SPEED` in `coin.hpp`, if you want to tune it after seeing it in game."
